costar-role-soul-urge-1.title: Soul Urge 1: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-1.statement: You are motivated by autonomy, novelty, and the feeling that your life is moved by your own will. You think for yourself, you see possibilities early, and your creativity comes alive when you can build something from the ground up. You want to lead, not out of ego, but because direction and ownership calm your nervous system and bring out your best judgment. The challenge is pacing. Headstrong impulses can outrun real-world skill. When that happens, doubt slips in and erodes your confidence. What you actually need is a rhythm of action and calibration. Choose projects where you can express your own vision, then keep your learning curve slightly ahead of your ambition. You dislike being managed by people who do not think clearly, yet feedback from competent mentors will sharpen you rather than diminish you. Recognition matters to you, not as flattery, but as confirmation that your effort created value. When you honor both your independence and your need for mastery, your drive becomes steady, your originality becomes useful, and leadership follows naturally.
costar-role-soul-urge-1.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-soul-urge-2.title: Soul Urge 2: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-2.statement: You are motivated by harmony, cooperation, and the felt sense that people can work together without doing violence to one another’s dignity. Your sensitivity is not a weakness. It is an instrument that reads the emotional climate and helps you make wise, considerate choices. You notice details, you prefer quality over flash, and you instinctively include others in your calculations. The risk is self-doubt. When conflict rises, you may defer too quickly, mistrust your own judgment, or stay quiet to keep the peace. Over time that breeds resentment and missed chances. Your task is to pair gentleness with backbone. Begin by stating what you see, then what you need, simply and calmly. You can still choose peace, but not at the expense of your rights or your truth. Surround yourself with environments that reflect beauty and order. They regulate your system and bring out your best work. Your spiritual streak and love of culture give you depth, and your cooperative nature makes you invaluable on teams where accuracy and goodwill matter. When you trust your perception and speak up with care, you become the person others rely on to turn good intentions into real outcomes.
costar-role-soul-urge-2.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-soul-urge-3.title: Soul Urge 3: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-3.statement: You are motivated by joy, creative expression, and the desire to lift the emotional tone of any room you enter. You think in images and possibilities. You communicate with color and story. You are at your best when ideas can breathe, people can laugh, and your imagination can translate into something others can feel. You also have a tender emotional system. When you are discouraged, you withdraw, worry over small things, or chase comfort that turns into avoidance. The medicine is scale and structure. Dream on a bigger canvas, then ground your art in simple routines that keep your momentum steady. Choose work and spaces that are bright, social, and mentally stimulating. You are a natural connector, and your optimism can be contagious, but remember that not every conversation is safe for every truth. Discernment protects intimacy and reputation. Your friendships matter deeply and love gives your expression purpose. When you honor your sensitivity, keep your promises to yourself, and let honesty guide your flair for performance, your gift to others is real elevation, not just entertainment.
costar-role-soul-urge-3.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-soul-urge-4.title: Soul Urge 4: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-4.statement: You are motivated by order, stability, and the deep satisfaction of building something solid and worthwhile. You prefer facts to fads. You plan, you prepare, and you take responsibility seriously. Clear direction settles you, while uncertainty makes you restless. You are loyal by nature and expect the same in return. Your shadow shows up as rigidity or reflexive skepticism, especially when new ideas threaten a system that already works. The growth path is disciplined flexibility. Keep your standards, and widen your lens. Ask for evidence, then try small experiments that let you update your models without abandoning what is proven. Make room for play within your schedule, especially in relationships. Brick by brick is your way, and it works, provided you leave space for inspiration and rest. When you pair patience with openness, your reliability becomes a foundation others can build on. You become the person who keeps projects honest, money accounted for, and promises kept.
costar-role-soul-urge-4.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-soul-urge-5.title: Soul Urge 5: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-5.statement: You are motivated by freedom, exploration, and the sense that life is an adventure to be lived, not a script to be followed. Change energizes you. People, travel, new ideas, and emerging trends all wake up your curiosity. Routine is necessary, but only in small doses, and you need it designed as launchpads, not cages. Your risks are scattered focus, impulsive choices, and overcommitting in the name of possibility. The antidote is intentional variety. Give your mind stimulating work with clear constraints. Use short sprints, visible checklists, and firm stop times to prevent drift. Choose careers with interaction, movement, and problem solving. Protect your freedom by keeping your word and your finances in order. Your resourcefulness can create joy for everyone around you, and your relationships thrive when you bring both spontaneity and consistency. When you learn to channel your appetite for experience into meaningful missions, you become a catalyst for progress who opens doors others did not know were there.
costar-role-soul-urge-5.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-soul-urge-6.title: Soul Urge 6: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-6.statement: You are motivated by devotion, responsibility, and the desire to create safety for the people and communities you love. You sense needs before they are spoken. You value commitment, fairness, and the stability of home. You will work hard for those you care about, and you expect respect in return. Your risk is overgiving and control disguised as care. When you carry more than your share, resentment grows, and those you protect can feel smothered rather than supported. The work is boundaries with warmth. Ask what is actually needed. Offer help that preserves dignity and autonomy. Invite collaboration instead of compliance. Your bluntness in the face of injustice is a strength, provided you aim it at the problem rather than the person. Build beauty into your daily life, and let others contribute to you as well. When you balance service with self-care and principle with flexibility, your love becomes a shelter that strengthens others rather than making them dependent.
costar-role-soul-urge-6.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-soul-urge-7.title: Soul Urge 7: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-7.statement: You are motivated by truth, depth, and the refinement of understanding. You want to know how things work, and why, beneath the surface. You seek quality in thought and in relationships. You are comfortable with solitude because thinking, studying, and testing ideas restore your clarity. Your standards are high. The risk is perfectionism that isolates you, or skepticism that turns connection into interrogation. Your task is to let curiosity be relational. Share your questions, not only your conclusions. Allow mystery where proof is not yet possible. Keep rituals that nourish your inner life, and let your body and emotions have a vote in decisions, not just your intellect. You are drawn to the unusual and the profound. That is not eccentricity, it is the right ecosystem for your mind. When you balance discernment with openness, you become a trusted source of wisdom who can separate signal from noise and bring hidden patterns into the light.

costar-role-soul-urge-8.title: Soul Urge 8: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-8.statement: You are motivated by impact, achievement, and the will to turn potential into performance. You think in terms of systems, leverage, and results. Pressure does not scare you, it focuses you. You like to lead and you prefer arenas where merit is visible. The traps are overreach, using people as means to an end, and mood swings that ripple through your team. The solution is disciplined power. Define goals clearly, measure what matters, and put ethics on the same line as outcomes. Learn to receive feedback without defensiveness. Develop people, not only projects. Your analytical instinct makes psychology, strategy, and organizational work natural fits. Appreciation may be scarce at the top, so secure your identity in your values, not in applause. When you combine ambition with responsibility and cooperation, you become the kind of builder who creates durable success and leaves others stronger in your wake.

costar-role-soul-urge-9.title: Soul Urge 9: role-specific bank
costar-role-soul-urge-9.statement: You are motivated by compassion, meaning, and the hope that your life can ease suffering and elevate the human story. You feel things intensely. You sense the emotional weather of a room and you care about justice, beauty, and mercy. Your ideals can inspire many people. The danger is burnout, disappointment, or being taken advantage of when your generosity runs ahead of discernment. The practice is boundaried compassion. Give, and also verify. Choose causes and relationships where your effort has structure and accountability. Let heartbreak teach you wisdom rather than cynicism. You can stand for your principles without attacking yourself or others. Romance and family matter deeply to you. Choose partners who share your values and your appetite for growth. When you allow your sensitivity to be guided by clarity, your influence becomes stabilizing rather than exhausting. You become the person who helps others believe in what is possible, while keeping both feet on the ground.

costar-role-birth-force-1.title: Birth Force 1: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-1.statement: You have leadership ability and qualities. You are individualized and act according to your own ideas and ways. You have a sharp mind, good concentration, and you are able to lead others with good management ability, will power, and courage. You are capable of overcoming any barrier when you make use of your creative abilities. Because you have a strong will and determination, you can be seen as dominant and forceful, and you may be classed as negative if you act without reasonable consideration. Your talents, used in a positive and constructive manner, bring the best results. Watch for negative tendencies such as dominance, egotism, a bossy manner, impatience, over confidence, and a know it all attitude. On the brighter side, you can be very successful by developing new projects that bring out your initiative and originality. New and original ideas are better than old ones and bring out your power of invention, design, and speaking. You have a unique sense of humor, enjoying wit and fun.

costar-role-birth-force-2.title: Birth Force 2: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-2.statement: You are a diplomatic type, sensitive, cooperative, and considerate. Your success will rely very much on your ability to help others get what they want, which comes from a fine and detailed mental quality in your makeup. Your sensitiveness, sincerity, and understanding should be part of a high standard of living, and they will strike harmony with others who value your ways. In business, you have the ability to be accurate and detailed, and you can bring people together for a common cause. This is a fine quality, yet difficulties may arise if you become too sensitive. That failing can make you negative and fearful instead of sincere and courageous. Now and then you may be uncertain and find it hard to decide what to do due to a fear of being wrong, since you want to do things right. Your accuracy makes you dislike mistakes, and you often hesitate. Keep attempting to do your best and you will gradually perfect your talents. If you share what you have with others and make use of your talent for doing things well, you will climb the ladder and stay at the top. Opportunity may be found with fine machinery, delicate instruments, the ministry, medicine, accounting, radio, electricity, statistics, and even specialized art.

costar-role-birth-force-3.title: Birth Force 3: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-3.statement: You are creative, imaginative, and deeply feeling. Many of your successes in life will come through the use of these natural talents. You have a gift with words, and your ability to express yourself well can bring financial rewards along this line of endeavor. Your ability to entertain and inspire is an open door to friendship and a social life. However, talking too much at the wrong time, possibly due to emotional eruptions, may get the best of you and bring regrets later. You can attract depressed people because your cheerful and happy disposition is seen as a welcoming card for others who want help lifting their spirits. There is a quiet side to you. You are very sensitive and can withdraw when hurt or criticized. You can also be critical of others and unconsciously express your views of other people’s mistakes, which can cause problems with friends and associates. You can change your luck at any time when you put your imagination to work. You may succeed in artistic lines, clothing, jewelry, entertainment, dancing, music, writing, acting, printing, publishing, designing, illustration, and drama pursuits.

costar-role-birth-force-4.title: Birth Force 4: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-4.statement: You are a practical type who likes to know what you are doing and do not care to take chances unless you are sure. You can be serious and fixed in your manner, but you are naturally honest and sincere. You can be particular with your likes and dislikes and like to feel sure about things, with a good sense of practical values. You have an ability to manage and can be fussy about things being done correctly, sometimes neglecting bigger things for smaller details. This can make you selective in associations since you are careful with possessions and can manage well. You have the ability to inspire confidence in others, as you are not easily carried away by frivolous or extravagant undertakings. You like quality, but can be too careful with money when demanding value. You work hard and have perseverance. You may argue or be disagreeable when you do not have things your own way, so watch out for this because it can make things difficult. You can apply your talents in building, contracting, organizing, bringing plans to form, buying and selling, managing well established businesses, technical educational fields, legal activities, property and real estate, and dealing with machinery and repairs. You are not suited to get rich quick schemes.

costar-role-birth-force-5.title: Birth Force 5: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-5.statement: You like freedom and have a natural interest in what is happening around you, and you seem to have many things going on at once. You are active, sometimes restless, and impatient if things move too slowly. Your versatility gives you the enthusiasm to keep things going, with a quick mind, imagination, and a gift for words. This is one of your attributes for personal and business success. Sometimes you act too quickly for your own good and can become easily discontented, and you may change your position. You do not like to spend unnecessary time getting things done and can be bold and determined when aroused to action, challenging any obstacle in your way. Many experiences will come to you and add to your success through knowledge you gain from living and from making contact with all kinds of people. Your skills may be applied through the public, travel, advertising, selling, business of trade and exchange, investment, legal matters, politics, and amusement.

costar-role-birth-force-6.title: Birth Force 6: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-6.statement: You have a caring attitude to work, you are an idealist, and you have strong opinions about what is right and wrong. You are generous, kind, sympathetic, and have a loving nature. You have an ability to do things in a big way and a natural tendency to assist others. This will attract financial rewards. People will seek your help and may take advantage of you, and this may even come from family and friends. Sometimes you give too much of yourself to others because you love to help. Guard against this, because it may cause losses and emotional unhappiness. You are fond of home, family, and relatives, and you appreciate beautiful things in life like music and art, luxuries, and comforts. You are more controlled by your feelings than you may admit, so when you are not appreciated you can become stubborn, unreasonable, unhappy, and feel like giving everything up. This is when you may become dominant and fussy. Business opportunities can come through the medical field, education, farming, cooking, welfare work, restaurants, decorating, hotels, artistic lines, animals, horticulture, gardens, singing, painting, and all lines of reform and education. You also belong to lines of work that make or control money.

costar-role-birth-force-7.title: Birth Force 7: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-7.statement: You are a natural thinker with an observing nature and an analytical mind. You can relate facts and size up situations from a technical and calculated standpoint. Your mind is tuned to higher thinking, with an ability to understand hidden and non apparent facts, which makes you a developer, inventor, and specialist. Knowledge is your power and one of the major keys to your success. You are naturally reserved, thoughtful, silent, and selective with your friends and even with where you live and work. You ask many questions, which can make you seem doubtful or cold and hard. You often need time out to think and read, because it is here that you discover where your direction lies. Many times in your life you will have to depend entirely upon your own ability. Lines of business where analysis, science, and technical ability provide opportunity suit you. Chemistry, history, research, criminal investigation, educational matters, medicine, law, engineering, invention, and radio are within your scope. The mystical and mysterious can capture your interest as well.

costar-role-birth-force-8.title: Birth Force 8: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-8.statement: You are a management type with strong organization skills. This places you among those who supervise, direct, and control matters. You are capable of taking charge, and you are ambitious, energetic, efficient, and capable of making good judgments. These talents give you authority and position in the social and business world. You have courage and energy to repeat your efforts until you reach your goal. There is a side of your character capable of mastering the hardest problems, and another side where commercial and material interests are the only goal. Sometimes you think too much about money and can use so much energy that you wear yourself out. Do not strive so hard that you neglect doing things well. You will find success through printing, publishing, editing, exploring, civil activities in government projects, supervising, coaching, finance, real estate, selling, exchange, archaeology, intelligence service, and areas of the mind like psychology, character analysis, history, governmental activity, statistics, and research.

costar-role-birth-force-9.title: Birth Force 9: role-specific bank
costar-role-birth-force-9.statement: You are a caring type who colors your affairs with emotion and can deal with people from any walk of life and at any level in business and private relationships. You are compassionate, generous, tolerant, and have a sensitive nature with a vivid imagination. You are capable of doing impressionable and lasting work in the world, in the arts and in business. You are broadminded and eager to take on responsibility, but sometimes meet with disappointment because you do not find the perfection you seek. Always strive to rise above disappointment and realize that perfection must be earned. You are good at helping others. You counsel and inspire people, but do not give to the point of weakness, because that causes delays and keeps you from doing the work your talents permit. You are an idealist and a romantic, and you have magnetism and the power to influence others. You love deeply and genuinely, and you are broadminded, tolerant, and compassionate. Opportunity comes along lines of drama, art, and emotionally based work. Literature, movies, education, and fields dealing with foods and health are areas where you can apply your skills. Government activities, business dealing with many people, employment, training people, the legal field, teaching, medicine, arts, the use of color, painting, and designing all fit your talents. costar-role-balance-number-1.statement: Draw strength from yourself, and be more willing to share your troubles with friends and family. You can be a loner in the face of problems, which can isolate you during troubled times. Be open to the advice of others. This will widen your perspective on the problem and give you new information on which to base your approach. Strength, creativity, and courage are the arms with which you will win the war.

costar-role-balance-number-2.title: Balance Number 2: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-2.statement: Use tact and diplomacy. Be less emotional. Be courageous in your approach to the solution you seek, rather than backing away from a problem because you fear confrontation. Work hard to diffuse tension. Your innate talent is to find a mutually satisfying solution for all. You are willing to compromise. Be more optimistic and lighthearted. Try not to blow problems out of proportion. You are overly sensitive and must work to be more balanced. Balance and harmony are available the minute you apply yourself to any problem. You can be the peacemaker.

costar-role-balance-number-3.title: Balance Number 3: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-3.statement: Be more lighthearted and optimistic in your approach to problems. Try to work with others toward a mutually satisfying solution. Use your considerable charm to influence the situation. You can be extremely emotional when faced with a problem. Control this tendency. You need a degree of objectivity. You may become too personally attached to the solution you seek, which can keep you from seeing that the outcome can be beneficial to all concerned.
costar-role-balance-number-3.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-balance-number-4.title: Balance Number 4: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-4.statement: Try to have perspective and a more lighthearted attitude toward emotionally charged issues. Control your anger. Discipline is your strength. Also, look at the larger picture and the need for compromise. Your sense of justice must be elevated to another level where forgiveness, compassion, and deep understanding are your guiding lights. A practical approach is to put yourself in the shoes of the person with whom you are in conflict. There are always more angles to a problem than you tend to acknowledge.
costar-role-balance-number-4.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-balance-number-5.title: Balance Number 5: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-5.statement: Focus on your problem rather than avoiding it. You may try to avoid the issue by indulging your senses to keep from feeling the pain of conflict. Be careful not to escape into food, alcohol, or drugs. You are capable of finding a highly creative solution to any situation the minute you put your mind to it. The answer lies well within your grasp.
costar-role-balance-number-5.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-balance-number-6.title: Balance Number 6: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-6.statement: Your strength lies in understanding people and the underlying conditions of a conflict. You can rely too heavily on friends and family to provide solace instead of handling the situation directly and responsibly. You may retreat to the good feelings provided by people who are not involved in your situation. Responsibility is the issue here. You helped create the situation in the first place, and you are an essential part of the solution. Accept your role.
costar-role-balance-number-6.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-balance-number-7.title: Balance Number 7: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-7.statement: You may retreat into a safe haven within yourself and hope you will not have to deal with the issue at hand. Yet the clarity and analytical abilities of your mind are sufficient to provide insight into the problem and a clear path to its solution. Work at confronting yourself and the issues you face unemotionally and calmly. You can be engulfed in the emotional aspects of the issue, which clouds your mind and prevents you from using your clarity to find an answer. Get past the emotion and you will find an answer.
costar-role-balance-number-7.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-balance-number-8.title: Balance Number 8: role-specific bank
costar-role-balance-number-8.statement: Use your considerable power in a balanced way. You may be tempted to use power in a manipulative way rather than confronting issues head on. Your strength lies in leadership and a structured approach. Avoid overreaching or taking unnecessary risks that could destabilize your position. Seek fairness and cooperation to maintain stability.
costar-role-balance-number-8.usage: Attributed source wording, not an observed personal fact. The prototype compares the role without asserting this description is true of the person.

costar-role-balance-number-9.statement: Your compassion and idealism guide you, but you may struggle with letting go of emotional attachments to outcomes. Focus on the bigger picture and use your influence to inspire others toward resolution. Avoid getting lost in others’ problems. Maintain boundaries to preserve your energy. Your strength is in understanding and uplifting, so channel this positively.

bridge-method-v1.title: Contextual correspondence method, version 1
bridge-method-v1.statement: Compare a number in its specific role with a selected planetary function and that planet's actual house, Tone and Pulse. A shared label is a proposed thematic link, not a physical aspect or independently validated association. No match count or strength score is calculated.
bridge-method-v1.usage: Research comparison only; the full PURE contextual interpretation and personal-report gates remain unchanged.
